settings.headline: Shipping & Delivery
settings.image_alt: Senseless range on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Dispatch
settings.body: Orders placed before 1pm on a working day are dispatched the same day; after 1pm or at weekends, the next working day. All orders ship from the United Kingdom via Royal Mail.

settings.headline: Delivery options
settings.body:
• Standard — £1.99 — 4–6 working days
  • Express — £2.99 — 2–3 working days
  • Next working day — £7.99 — order by 1pm

settings.headline: Tracking your order
settings.body: A confirmation email with a tracking link is sent on dispatch. Track directly at royalmail.com/track-your-item. No confirmation within 24 hours — check spam or contact cs@senseless.uk.

settings.headline: Problems with your delivery
settings.body: Damaged, missing, or late beyond the expected window — contact cs@senseless.uk with your order number. Report delivery issues within 14 days of the expected delivery date.

settings.question: Free shipping?
settings.answer: All orders carry a delivery charge; Standard from £1.99.

settings.question: Change my address after ordering?
settings.answer: If not yet dispatched, contact cs@senseless.uk; once dispatched it can't be changed.

settings.question: Not home for delivery?
settings.answer: The courier follows its standard redelivery process; check your tracking link.

settings.question: Order hasn't arrived?
settings.answer: Check tracking first; if the window has passed with no update, contact cs@senseless.uk with your order number.
